summary: - **[key4hep/k4FWCore#413](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/413)** — `OverlayTiming` gains a `RandomMixBackgroundFiles` option. It treats each file in a background group as an independent event source and draws from a shuffled permutation, which is reshuffled once exhausted. Runs that overlay fewer events than there are files, such as beam-induced background stored as one pseudo-event per file, therefore no longer see only the first few files.

- **[key4hep/k4GaudiPandora#51](https://github.com/key4hep/k4GaudiPandora/pull/51)** — `DDPandoraPFANewAlgorithm` adds 2D theta–energy corrections for the EM and hadronic branches. Each branch reads a JSON calibration table from a new property (`ElectromagneticThetaEnergyCorrectionFile`, `HadronicThetaEnergyCorrectionFile`), and invalid tables stop the job at `initialize()`; without a file the correction is the identity, so existing configurations are unchanged. k4GaudiPandora now depends on nlohmann json.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#127](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/127)** — Outside-in CKF (`PropagateBackward`) now starts at the outermost seed space point instead of the innermost, so outer seed hits are no longer dropped from the final track. Backward tracks are also reversed to inside-out order and stop at the reference surface. Seed parameters are now estimated, with the field evaluated, at the start space point, which also affects the default inside-out seeding.

- **[key4hep/k4Reco#75](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Reco/pull/75)** — Fixes a crash in `GaudiTrkUtils` for trackers with detector ID > 20. This affects, for example, the silicon wrapper of ALLEGRO and IDEA; the old limit was an ILC/LCIO-era assumption.

- **[key4hep/k4Reco#74](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Reco/pull/74)** — `DDPlanarDigi` stores the per-layer time resolution as the tracker-hit time error introduced in EDM4hep 1.2. The value stays 0 without time smearing, and k4Reco still builds against older EDM4hep.

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1706](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1706)** — Fixes volume divisions, where volume and placement extensions were not assigned. This previously caused null-pointer exceptions when traversing the volume hierarchy of divided volumes.

- **[key4hep/k4geo#669](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/669)** — Adds the first version of the ALFA FCC-ee detector concept (`ALFA_o1_v00`). It includes a Grainita ECAL barrel driver with its SD action, an outer tracker, a new rho-phi-theta grid segmentation, a steering file and tests.

- **[key4hep/k4geo#674](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/674)** — `ALLEGRO_o1_v04` now includes `DectDimensions` and other common files from `ALLEGRO_o1_v03`, keeping only the HCAL files version-specific. This makes the silicon wrapper and other dimensions identical between versions and avoids divergence such as k4geo#673.

- **[HEP-FCC/FCC-config#402](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/402)** — ALLEGRO digi/reco gains a `siDigitizer` option to select the detailed `VTXdigitizerDetailed` silicon digitiser instead of `DDPlanarDigi`. Pixel pitches are now read from the compact files, and DDPlanarDigi resolutions remain overridable; the detailed digitiser's thresholds and smearing still need tuning.

- **[HEP-FCC/k4RecCalorimeter#291](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/k4RecCalorimeter/pull/291)** — `TopoCaloNoisyCells` stores noise data in an indexed vector held by `CaloCellConstantsSvc` instead of a per-tool map. This is faster, uses less memory and avoids duplication when the tool is configured several times; ALLEGRO reconstruction results are verified unchanged.

- **[HEP-FCC/FCCDIRAC#21](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCCDIRAC/pull/21)** — Adds the summer2026 Pythia+Delphes (IDEA card) production of ee→tt̄ at √s = 365 GeV, requested via DRS#4, as production ID 17138.

- **[key4hep/key4hep-spack#943](https://github.com/key4hep/key4hep-spack/pull/943)** — The CVMFS nightlies setup script now warns that Spack-based nightlies are no longer built, so users should move to the LCG-based stacks.
